ruling.explanation: To the rider: your account is not supported by the record. The trace does show a 13.76 km drive against a 6.4 km booked optimal — an excess of 7.36 km, or 115% — which would ordinarily be a material deviation under POL-RD-01. But the detour was yours. Chat message MSG-00109-001, sent by you at 18:22:06, 56 seconds after the meter started at 18:21:10, reads 'hi can stop at jurong point first? need to grab something 5 min'; it carries a platform-resolved waypoint at Jurong Point, and the driver agreed at 18:22:31. The GPS trace corroborates it, placing the vehicle stationary 38 m from that waypoint for 366 seconds — well inside POL-RD-04's 200 m test. All three limbs of POL-RD-04 are met, so the excess distance between leaving and rejoining the optimal corridor is excluded; here that is the whole excess, because the vehicle left the corridor at the pickup and did not rejoin it until the dropoff. No deviation survives, and the SGD 21.32 fare you were charged stands. Your refund request is declined, and no money is returned to you. To the driver: on the same record you are owed for distance you drove but were not paid for. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00109) bills 9.60 km; the trace (EV-GPS-00109) records 13.76 km. The shortfall of 4.16 km exceeds the 1.0 km gate in POL-RD-04, and at SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 3.12, rounded UP to SGD 3.15 and within the SGD 15.00 cap. You are awarded SGD 3.15. No referral issues. There is no repeat-deviation pattern under POL-RD-06 — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 511 — and once the rider-requested detour is excluded no material deviation remains, so no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral fires. There are no unmatched ERP gantries or surcharges, so POL-RD-09(4) does not fire. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger applies: the trip identifiers match (TRP-00109), the trace is unimpaired (207 fixes at 10 s, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), no timestamps conflict, and no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing field. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00109-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not relied on. Every artifact that carries a deciding fact — the chat log, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — carries weight 1.0, so confidence is 0.90.
